missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Муж' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'работает'. 'Мой' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'в больнице' gives the prepositional place of work.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Мужа' is the animate accusative direct object of 'люблю', taking the genitive-style ending. 'Своего' agrees in the masculine accusative, marking the speaker's own husband.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Мужа' is in the genitive case after 'нет', the standard negation of existence. The phrase states that the friend has no husband.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Мужу' is in the dative case as the indirect object, the person receiving the gift. 'Новые часы' is the accusative direct object of 'подарила'.

missions.phrase: Я иду в кино с мужем.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'С мужем' uses the instrumental form 'мужем' after 'с' to express going together. 'В кино' gives the accusative destination.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О муже' uses the prepositional form 'муже' after 'о' to mark the topic of conversation. 'Её' shows whose husband is being discussed.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Муж' is nominative as the subject, with 'добрый человек' as the nominative predicate. 'Очень' intensifies the description.

missions.phrase: Все мужья ждали жён у входа.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Мужья' is the irregular nominative plural of 'муж', acting as the subject of 'ждали'. 'Жён' is the genitive-style animate accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Мужа' is the animate accusative direct object of 'знаю'. 'Давно' adds duration, and 'её' marks whose husband is meant.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Без мужа' uses the genitive form 'мужа' after 'без' to express absence. The impersonal 'ей было трудно' adds the dative experiencer.
